criteria.evidence: Horizon Bank’s official branch page identifies 1980 Northwestern Ave, West Lafayette. Raw Indiana LiDAR footprint objectid 430274 is an 8-vertex polygon at that site, from 2018-derived data. I independently transformed the raw WGS84 vertices into the project’s campus coordinates and compared them to the saved wall mesh: symmetric maximum nearest-vertex residual 0.000112 m; ground-projected polygon area 392.15 m²; independently reprojecting the same ring to EPSG:3857 gives 678.08 m², matching the layer area attribute 678.09 m².
criteria.limitations: The statewide LiDAR outline is not a surveyed legal wall boundary and may omit post-2018 changes.

criteria.evidence: The model’s eight distinct plan vertices register directly to the Indiana polygon with the project’s disclosed local transform; no additional translation, rotation, or scaling is needed. Source/model local XY bounds are -744.087/-721.630 by 2245.891/2268.321 m and -744.087/-721.630 by 2245.891/2268.321 m, respectively.
criteria.limitations: Accuracy inherits the approximate local degrees-to-meters projection and the source polygon’s cartographic tolerance.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The April 2026 Google Street View pano shows a single visible occupied story, a raised central entry/sign tower, and a broad shallow dark roof. The asset reproduces those broad elements; evaluated Z bounds are -0.18 to 6.19 m.
criteria.limitations: No elevation or surveyed height source was found. Wall height 4.55 m and entry tower height 6.05 m are explicitly model estimates; the render’s roof surface is simplified and its precise pitch/edge profile cannot be verified from the oblique pano.

criteria.evidence: The Street View reference shows red-brown masonry, pale vertical/jamb trim, repeated dark glazed bays, and a tall arched entry beneath a green Horizon sign. The model has corresponding brick/trim/glazing materials, four front window assemblies, side windows, the arched glazed doorway and sign tower. I visually compared the rendered exterior against the April 2026 panorama.
criteria.limitations: Street-level vegetation and perspective obscure parts of the facade. The exact masonry/stone specification, full window spacing on concealed elevations, and sign/door dimensions are not established by a measured elevation.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh-opened the exact SHA asset in Blender 5.2.3 LTS. Expected scene and exported collection are present, with 80 export objects (79 meshes), 7 named materials, all meshes assigned materials, no external image files, and no linked libraries. The interior is in a separate scene explicitly named as schematic/not-as-built. Source record includes official branch identity, raw LiDAR source and identifier, CRS/transform, retrieval/source dates, Street View pano and capture date, method, and uncertainty.
criteria.limitations: Interior is only schematic because no as-built plan was available; this is disclosed in its scene name and source record.

evidence.identity_claim: Official branch page lists 1980 Northwestern Ave, West Lafayette, Indiana.
evidence.area_method_note: The feature attribute SHAPE__Area is calculated in the service native Web Mercator frame, while the footprint vertices are returned in WGS84. For a like-for-like comparison, both the source and model polygons are measured in the project local frame; no mismatch is inferred from their different projection areas.
evidence.street_view_observed: Google Street View pano BEIDnVCsMXxMoQp6FvbLUA, capture displayed as Apr 2026; one-story masonry bank, pale trim, repeated glazed bays, raised center tower, arched entry and green Horizon sign, shallow dark roof.

findings: PASS: exact eight-corner LiDAR plan outline and campus registration independently confirmed from raw feature geometry.
PASS: principal exterior identity cues from the April 2026 Street View are represented and texturing is portable/procedural.
LIMITATION: all vertical dimensions and the roof profile remain estimates without a public elevation or survey.
LIMITATION: interior is schematic and must not be presented as an as-built floor plan.
